entries.body:
Summary of work so far (rounds 1-2 of 11 released; rounds 03-11 still to be released):

Log format (same in R1 and R2): `2026-09-14THH:MM:SSZ LEVEL  <service> <message> key=val ...`
- Routine noise to skip: request ok, health ok, heartbeat, gc cycle, slow query.
- Pool signal format: `WARN <svc> db pool exhausted wait_ms=N in_use=X/X`.
- The format may change in later rounds.

Round 1 (/task/fixtures/round-01/):
- board.md: header only; no threads.
- changes.md:
  - line 3: CHG-107 PROPOSED, raise HPA max replicas for search tier (not applied).
  - line 4: CHG-113 APPLIED, build 8.23.7 to search-api, sets `cache.ttl_s=-1`. This is an invalid value and a likely BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT/CACHE_STAMPEDE source. Cite round-01/changes.md:4 if a search-api incident appears.
  - line 5: CHG-114 APPLIED, build 8.23.7 to auth-svc, no config changes.
- inventory-svc.log db pool exhausted at lines 5, 9, 28, 30, 45, 52.
- All other logs in R1 contain only routine lines.

Round 2 (/task/fixtures/round-02/):
- No changes.md in this round.
- board.md:3 opens Thread A.
  - Cause: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, confirmed.
  - Services: inventory-svc, with impact also on notify-worker.
  - Status: ongoing.
- inventory-svc.log db pool exhausted at lines 3, 9, 19, 30, 33, 54, 67, 68, 74, 78.
- notify-worker.log db pool exhausted at lines 6, 14, 29, 32, 34, 37, 40, 45, 57.
- auth-svc, search-api and shipping-svc logs contain only routine lines.
- search-api shows no symptoms yet despite CHG-113.

Incident threads:
- A: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED.
  - Services: inventory-svc, notify-worker.
  - Status: ongoing, set by round-02/board.md:3.
  - Evidence: round-02/board.md:3, round-02/logs/inventory-svc.log:3-19, round-02/logs/notify-worker.log:6-14, round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log:5-9.

Follow-ups: none opened or closed yet.

Workspace: notes in /task/workspace/notes.md (R1 notes appended).

Next steps:
- Advance round by round through rounds 3-11.
- Each round, read board.md (latest update per thread wins; unmentioned fields are unchanged), changes.md if present, and the non-routine log lines.
- Use the same filter script, and adapt it if the log format changes.
- Watch for:
  - a search-api thread tied to CHG-113;
  - cause changes on Thread A;
  - status changes on Thread A;
  - false-alarm threads;
  - follow-up codes opened or closed.
- Collect file:line refs for each thread's current cause and status.
- Give the final answer only after round 11.

[step 5] execute
